title: ichnocarpus roxburghii
intro: Ichnocarpus roxburghii, commonly known as Roxburgh's Starflower, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Roxburgh's Starflower include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
